facts.fact: The document gives the Ministério da Economia Digital's 2025 appropriation as CVE 369,781,930.
The Ministério da Economia Digital's appropriation fell 73.4% from CVE 1,390,965,632 in 2024 to CVE 369,781,930 in 2025, per the document; the date is the plan's year.
